quote: The Provider shall ensure monthly availability of 99.5%.
explanation: The provider failed to meet the contractual 99.5% monthly availability threshold, delivering only 98.7% due to a 9-hour outage. This triggers entitlement to service credits under clause 5.2. Per clause 5.3, service credits are the sole and exclusive remedy for SLA failures.
ruling_rationale: The event confirms a 9-hour outage on 2026-11-02 resulting in projected monthly availability of 98.7%. Clause 5.1 states: 'The Provider shall ensure monthly availability of 99.5%.' The 0.8 percentage point shortfall (99.5% - 98.7% = 0.8%) constitutes a clear breach of the contractual availability requirement. The breach is mathematical and unambiguous.
